fresh_train.seed_rule: epoch e (1-based) uses sampler seed seed_base + e
fresh_train.sampling: dem.compile_sampler(seed) on the non-decomposed DEM, sample() calls of 10000 shots, the same draw as _fresh_shots(d, p, shots_per_epoch, seed)
fresh_train.order: sample order, no shuffling (fresh shots are i.i.d.)
fresh_train.same_schedule_for: every arm, model seed and lambda
fresh_train.reproducibility: stim's seeded sampling is platform-dependent: reproducible on the same kind of machine
